errors.text_span: Диаграмата представя дял на конкретните ресурси от общия износ на стоки от България за 2019 година по данни на НСИ
errors.evidence: The atom specifies that the chart represents the distribution of different categories from a general value, but the machine-generated description inaccurately claims it represents export data for Bulgaria in 2019.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the sectors are ordered according to the names in the legend.
